name: Agent Context tab: attach docs, reorder, persist, budget warning, detach
description: Deterministic (no model call) walk through the Context tab of the seeded Security Reviewer on acme/payments-api. Ticks specs/public-api.md and specs/security-baseline.md (each saves at once; badge reads '2 of 6 attached'), keyboard-reorders them, leaves and comes back to confirm the attachments persisted, then ticks docs/data-retention.md, which alone exceeds the e2e budget of 400 tokens (PROJECT_CONTEXT_BUDGET_TOKENS, set by scripts/e2e.sh and e2e-web.yml), so the budget warning names it. Unticks all three at the end so the flow can run again. Attachments do not create agent versions. The reorder is exercised but its resulting order is not asserted: agent-browser has no ordered-text wait (the order is asserted by ContextDocPicker.test.tsx and the server integration test). Assumes a freshly-seeded DB and the fixture mirror; flow 08 only touches Test Quality Reviewer, so the order of flows does not matter.
